request.subject: UNIT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Recolour his bright red tunic and sleeves to plain cream-white cloth with cool grey shading. Paint the whole face of the round shield solid bright red, keeping its light steel rim and boss. Keep the bright red helmet crest, the steel helmet and the sword. Keep the face, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the feet.
